# codebase-agent-os-v8

Iteration v8 of the agent-OS demo line.

## Stack & contents

TypeScript + Vite. ~20 files under `code/agent-os-v8/src/{styles,views}` plus gateway and storage modules. Source recorded as `/home/trajan/Projects/agent-os-v8`.

## Why this is here

v8 of the Agent OS line — the cleanest TypeScript rewrite. The gateway/storage modular split is worth comparing against `codebase-agent-os-bridge` (Node) and the EMA daemon's own surface seam.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-agent-os-v8:code/agent-os-v8/CLAUDE.md
git show origin/codebase-agent-os-v8:code/agent-os-v8/vite.config.ts
```
